records.question: Which company had the largest increase in revenue from 2023 to 2024, in euros?
records.generated_sql:
WITH revenue_change AS (
    SELECT 
        lei, 
        company_name, 
        fiscal_year, 
        value_eur AS revenue
    FROM 
        financial_fact
    WHERE 
        metric = 'revenue'
)
SELECT 
    lei, 
    company_name, 
    (revenue_2024 - revenue_2023) AS revenue_change_eur
FROM (
    SELECT 
        lei, 
        company_name, 
        2023 AS fiscal_year, 
        revenue AS revenue_2023
    FROM 
        revenue_change
    WHERE 
        fiscal_year = 2023
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        lei, 
        company_name, 
        2024 AS fiscal_year, 
        revenue AS revenue_2024
    FROM 
        revenue_change
    WHERE 
        fiscal_year = 2024
) AS revenue_changes
GROUP BY 
    lei, 
    company_name, 
    revenue_2023, 
    revenue_2024
ORDER BY 
    revenue_change_eur DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;
records.executed_sql: WITH revenue_change AS (SELECT lei, company_name, fiscal_year, value_eur AS revenue FROM financial_fact WHERE metric = 'revenue') SELECT lei, company_name, (revenue_2024 - revenue_2023) AS revenue_change_eur FROM (SELECT lei, company_name, 2023 AS fiscal_year, revenue AS revenue_2023 FROM revenue_change WHERE fiscal_year = 2023 UNION ALL SELECT lei, company_name, 2024 AS fiscal_year, revenue AS revenue_2024 FROM revenue_change WHERE fiscal_year = 2024) AS revenue_changes GROUP BY lei, company_name, revenue_2023, revenue_2024 ORDER BY revenue_change_eur DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

ORDER BY a.revenue - b.revenue DESC LIMIT 1

records.question: ¿Cuál fue el ratio agregado de patrimonio neto sobre activos de bancos y aseguradoras en 2024?
records.generated_sql:
WITH financial_data AS (
    SELECT 
        fiscal_year,
        SUM(total_equity) AS total_equity_sum,
        SUM(total_assets) AS total_assets_sum
    FROM 
        financial_fact
    JOIN 
        company 
    ON 
        financial_fact.lei = company.lei
    WHERE 
        company.is_financial = true AND fiscal_year = 2024
    GROUP BY 
        fiscal_year
)
SELECT 
    fiscal_year,
    total_equity_sum / total_assets_sum AS equity_ratio
FROM 
    financial_data;
records.executed_sql: WITH financial_data AS (SELECT fiscal_year, SUM(total_equity) AS total_equity_sum, SUM(total_assets) AS total_assets_sum FROM financial_fact JOIN company ON financial_fact.lei = company.lei WHERE company.is_financial = TRUE AND fiscal_year = 2024 GROUP BY fiscal_year) SELECT fiscal_year, total_equity_sum / total_assets_sum AS equity_ratio FROM financial_data LIMIT 200
records.reference_sql:
SELECT equity_ratio FROM year_aggregate_ratios
WHERE fiscal_year = 2024 AND is_financial
